title: 第15章 十赌九诈第16章 丑八怪出门
content_zh:
“没有问题。”
韩林直接答应。
长脸男子迟疑了一下，也点点头。
“好。”
唐川不再多言，抓起骰盅一阵摇晃后，重重盖在桌上：“下注吧？”
长脸男子没了办法，偷偷朝人群中的壮汉投去求助眼神。壮汉紧皱的眉头松了松，摸摸鼻尖。
长脸男子心头一喜，当即押了一千积分在‘大’的一边。
韩林发现，骰盅里面确实是大，心中暗感惊讶：“难道我之前想错了，这家伙真有本事不成？”
不过两人对赌，就不能同时押一方。
但好在，这赌局最低限制是一百积分，所以取出一百积分押在了小上面。
“买定离手！”
唐川见状直接打开骰盅：“三三五，十一点大。”
“这小子，还是不行啊。”
“非也，我倒觉得他厉害，你没看到他虽然输了，却只输一百积分吗。”
“对哦……”
伴随着结果呈现，围观之人不禁一阵交头接耳。
“韩林，你也太小心了吧，一局押一百积分，要玩到什么时候？”壮汉挑衅道。
“是吗？那你说多少合适？”
“五百起步吧！”
“行！”

韩林直接答应，让现场的情绪一下高涨起来，而长脸男子，则是一副等着看好戏的表情。
第二局，轮到韩林先押。
他直接将全部积分，押在了小上面。
这一幕，让长脸男子心头一跳，朝壮汉看去，见对方捏着下巴，顿时已经明白结果。
如此情况，他哪里敢乱来，最终只押了个保底五百积分。
不出所料，最后韩林胜出，赢走五百，除去上一局输的一百，还倒赚四百积分。
如此一幕，顿时让在场之人纷纷觉得，无论是韩林还是那名长脸男子，都有几分真本事。
接下来，两人连赌了数局，场面也是僵持不下。
韩林和长脸男子，完全保持着，谁先下注谁就赢的局面，令观战之人一片哗然。
就连负责摇骰子的唐川也有些傻眼，他可以对天发誓，自己是绝对公平公正的！
他想了想，忽然改变了手法，仿佛耍杂技一样，抓着骰盅一阵胡乱摇晃，随后才以迅雷不及掩耳之势，啪的一声将骰盅盖在桌上。
“马师兄，请先下注。”
content_en:
"No problem."
Han Lin agreed directly.
The long-faced man hesitated for a moment and then nodded.
"Okay."
Tang Chuan said no more, grabbed the dice cup and shook it for a while, then placed it heavily on the table: "Shall we place a bet?"
The long-faced man had no choice but to secretly cast a look of help at the strong man in the crowd. The strong man relaxed his frown and touched the tip of his nose.
The long-faced man was delighted and immediately bet a thousand points on the 'big' side.
Han Lin discovered that the inside of the dice cup was really big, and he was secretly surprised: "Did I think wrong before? Is this guy really capable?"
However, if two people are betting against each other, they cannot bet on one side at the same time.
But fortunately, the minimum limit for this gambling game is one hundred points, so I took out one hundred points and bet on the small one.
"Buy and leave!"
Tang Chuan saw this and opened the dice cup directly: "Three three five, eleven o'clock is high."
"This kid still can't do it."
"No, I think he is great. Didn't you see that although he lost, he only lost a hundred points."
"Yes..."
As the results were presented, the onlookers couldn't help but whisper among themselves.
"Han Lin, are you too careful? You bet 100 points in a game. How long are you going to play?" the strong man challenged.
"Really? How much would you say is appropriate?"
"Start at five hundred!"
"Okay!"
Han Lin agreed directly, which made the mood on the scene rise. The long-faced man looked like he was waiting for a good show.
In the second game, it was Han Lin's turn to bet first.
He directly bet all his points on Xiao.
This scene made the long-faced man's heart skip a beat. He looked towards the strong man and saw the other man holding his chin, and he immediately understood the result.
Under such circumstances, how could he dare to act recklessly? In the end, he only bet a guaranteed 500 points.
As expected, Han Lin won in the end and won 500 points. Excluding the 100 points he lost in the previous game, he also earned 400 points.
Such a scene immediately made everyone present feel that both Han Lin and the long-faced man had some real abilities.
Next, the two gambled for several rounds, and the situation was also in a stalemate.
Han Lin and the long-faced man completely maintained the situation of whoever placed the bet first would win, which caused an uproar among the spectators.
Even Tang Chuan, who was in charge of rolling the dice, was a little dumbfounded. He could swear to God that he was absolutely fair and just!
He thought for a moment, then suddenly changed his technique, as if performing acrobatics, he grabbed the dice cup and shook it randomly for a while, and then with lightning speed, he covered the dice cup on the table with a snap.
"Senior Brother Ma, please place your bet first."
